boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named California-campus environments documented by the College as library, classroom, residence, or commons spaces. Confirm day-of access before settling in.

cards.title: St. Bernardine of Siena Library
cards.subtitle: Academic quadrangle, California campus
cards.notes: Start beneath the historic nave ceiling, then use the book collections and College computer access for reading or research.
cards.short_summary: A purpose-built academic library with natural light, collections, and College computer access.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes the library as a setting for serious study and says College computers there provide email and internet access.
cards.access_notes: The College's student information says email and internet access are available through College computers in the Library; observe current campus rules.

cards.title: St. Augustine Hall
cards.subtitle: Classroom building, California campus
cards.notes: Check for an available classroom and use it for course preparation; return the room promptly if a scheduled class needs it.
cards.short_summary: The campus map identifies this building as classrooms, and the College makes classrooms available for study.
cards.evidence_claim: The official campus map identifies St. Augustine Hall as a classroom building.
cards.access_notes: The California Code of Conduct says classrooms are available for study; use only an unoccupied room and follow College directions.

cards.title: St. Gladys Hall
cards.subtitle: Classroom building, California campus
cards.notes: Look for a vacant classroom between scheduled uses, spread out your texts, and leave the space ready for its next class.
cards.short_summary: A named classroom hall on the official California campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: The official campus map identifies St. Gladys Hall as a classroom building.
cards.access_notes: The California Code of Conduct says classrooms are available for study; use only an unoccupied room and follow College directions.

cards.title: Albertus Magnus Science Hall
cards.subtitle: Academic building, California campus
cards.notes: Use an available classroom for reading or problem sets, while keeping laboratory and scheduled instructional areas clear.
cards.short_summary: A named science academic building on the California campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The official campus map identifies Albertus Magnus Science Hall as a campus academic building.
cards.access_notes: The College identifies Albertus Magnus Hall as providing laboratories and classrooms; the Code of Conduct says classrooms are available for study.

cards.title: St. Joseph Commons Dining Area
cards.subtitle: St. Joseph Commons, California campus
cards.notes: Bring a reading assignment during an open interval, choose a table away from meal service, and yield it when dining needs take priority.
cards.short_summary: A named dining-area study option in the College's commons building.
cards.evidence_claim: The California Code of Conduct says the dining area of St. Joseph Commons is available for study.
cards.access_notes: Use only when it is open and does not interfere with dining service; comply with the College's conduct and dress requirements.

cards.title: St. Cecilia Lecture & Concert Hall
cards.subtitle: Auditorium and coffee shop, California campus
cards.notes: Use the named hall only when it is open and not programmed; choose a quiet seat and avoid interrupting event setup or service.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed lecture and concert destination with a coffee shop.
cards.evidence_claim: The official campus map identifies St. Cecilia Lecture & Concert Hall as an auditorium and coffee-shop location.
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on College programming and coffee-shop operations; confirm access locally before using the space for study.

cards.entity_name: St. Katherine of Alexandria Hall Study Room
cards.title: St. Katherine of Alexandria Hall Study Room
cards.subtitle: Residence hall study room, California campus
cards.notes: Residents can use the hall's study-room computer for College email, then keep conversation low so nearby residents can rest or work.
cards.short_summary: A residence-hall study room with College computer access for residents.
cards.evidence_claim: College student information says study-room computers are located in each residence hall, and the campus map lists St. Katherine of Alexandria Hall as a residence.
cards.access_notes: Resident access only; follow residence-hall quiet and visitation rules.

warnings: Many study locations are campus- or resident-access spaces. The College's public pages do not publish current room-by-room schedules, hours, or reservation rules; verify availability locally.
